title: CI workflow: pytest, claude plugin validate, lore check, quest agents check
description: PR #1 shipped with no checks configured. Add a GitHub Actions workflow so every PR runs the engine tests on Python 3.9 and 3.12, validates the plugin manifest, and runs lore check and quest agents --check.

acceptanceCriteria.text: a workflow runs pytest on Python 3.9 and 3.12 for every PR into dev
the workflow runs lore check and quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude
the required checks are green on the PR that adds the workflow

implementationNotes: First CI run (run 37535959418 on 8605757) surfaced two things. (1) lore check failed with lore 0.9.2: docs/index.md's stamp is stale and the committed schemas need >= 0.11.0 (verified: 0.9.3 10 errors, 0.11.0 and 0.12.0 clean); the workflow now pins lore to the newest 'by: lore/' stamp in docs/, and lore check went green on 34cb0e1. (2) pytest failed on ubuntu-latest because procps ps truncates command lines to $COLUMNS: an engine bug, filed as HS-16 and fixed in PR #5 (Linux container control: pre-fix 1 failed, fixed 30 passed). AC3 waits on PR #5 landing; then rebase this branch onto dev and require a green run on the rebased head. Merging #5 needs the user's sign-off.

Evidence: run 37538701046 on 7df7d4e (PR #4 head after merging dev with the HS-16 fix): pytest (3.9), pytest (3.12), plugin validate, lore check all success. AC1: the pytest matrix runs on pull_request (every PR, including into dev). AC2: the 'lore check' job runs lore check and quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude. AC3: with the user's approval, a dev-only ruleset 'dev required checks' (id 24613343) now requires all four contexts (integration GitHub Actions 15368, names verified ASCII from the run); gh pr checks 4 --required lists all four as pass. The shared 'protect trunk branches' ruleset (dev+main) was left unchanged, so main has no required checks.
finalSummary: Delivered in https://github.com/opum-ai/housekeeping-skills/pull/4: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs pytest on Python 3.9 and 3.12, claude plugin validate, lore check (lore pinned to the newest bundle stamp) and quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude on every PR and on pushes to dev/main. Validated by run 37538701046 on commit 7df7d4e, all four green. Required on dev via ruleset 24613343. The first run surfaced an engine bug, fixed separately as HS-16 in PR #5.
